mapper.select: SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectExpertEncryptedInfoByBrno */ ei.encpt_exprt_inst_eml_nm AS "encptEmail", m.encpt_mbr_flnm AS "encptFlnm" FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_exprt_task et JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_exprt_info ei ON et.exprt_no = ei.exprt_no JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_inst i ON ei.brno = i.brno JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_inst_task it ON et.bzmn_task_mng_no = it.bzmn_task_mng_no JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_mbr_info m ON ei.mbr_no = m.mbr_no WHERE it.tkcg_exprt_no = et.exprt_no AND i.brno = #{brno} LIMIT 1

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectEmpInfoByEmpNo */ emp_nm AS "empNm" , encpt_emp_eml_nm AS "encptEmpEmlNm" , di.dept_nm AS "deptNm" FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_emp_info ei LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_dept_info di ON ei.dept_no = di.dept_no WHERE emp_no = #{empNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_inst
AND (del_yn IS NULL OR del_yn = 'N')
ORDER BY reg_dt DESC

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectInstAndName */ i.inst_nm AS inst_nm , m.encpt_mbr_flnm AS encpt_mbr_flnm FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_exprt_info ei JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_inst i ON ei.brno = i.brno JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_mbr_info m ON ei.mbr_no = m.mbr_no WHERE ei.mbr_no = #{mbrNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectMbrNo */ m.mbr_no AS mbrNo FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_mbr_info m WHERE m.mbr_Id = #{mbrId} LIMIT 1
